params.name: user_guid
params.description: The unique identifier for the user. Defined by MX.

items.docs: This endpoint will automatically create budgets for several categories based on existing transactions; these budgets are returned as an array. Specifically, budgets will only be generated if the `user` has at least one `transaction` in a given category during each of the two previous calendar months.
